# Weekly Scope Gating Skill

## When to use

- At the start of every weekly assignment task
- Before selecting any other skill

## Rule

Only implement what the current week explicitly requires.

## Workflow

1. Read the weekly requirements first.
2. Map each requirement to existing skills.
3. Use only the minimum required skills.
4. Keep all other skills as reference only.
5. If a task is future-phase, record it as deferred roadmap work.
